Question:
Let \(x_1,\) \(x_2,\) \(\ldots,\) \(x_n\) be a sequence of integers such that

(i) \(-1 \le x_i \le 2,\) for \(i = 1,\) \(2,\) \(3,\) \(\ldots,\) \(n\);

(ii) \(x_1 + x_2 + \cdots + x_n = 19;\) and

(iii) \(x_1^2 + x_2^2 + \cdots + x_n^2 = 99.\)

Let \(m\) and \(M\) be the minimal and maximal possible values of \(x_1^3 + x_2^3 + \cdots + x_n^3,\) respectively. What is \(\dfrac{M}{m}?\)
